prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle entering from the cross street. Claimant reports a concussion and has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Photos of both vehicles requested from the insured.

Entry 2: Received the police report. Responding officer cites the other driver for failure to yield on a left turn. Signal phase data from the city traffic department requested to confirm right-of-way. Liability appears clear pending signal timing confirmation.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney. Counsel confirms the client was treated at an urgent care facility and later referred for a neurological evaluation for concussion symptoms. Requested itemized medical records and a signed authorization for release. Attorney indicates a demand package will follow once treatment is complete.

Entry 4: Inspected the insured vehicle at the repair shop. Driver-side door, rear quarter panel, and side curtain airbag deployed. Estimate ordered and frame measurement requested to check for structural damage. Rental coverage confirmed for the insured while the vehicle is out of service.

Entry 5: Reviewed medical records received from claimant's counsel. Diagnosis documented as mild concussion with ongoing headaches and sensitivity to light. Referred file to the bodily injury unit for evaluation and reserve review. Follow-up with counsel scheduled for next week to discuss status of treatment and anticipated settlement timeline.
